newsitem.title: USA: Comcast taps banks for Scripps acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Comcast taps banks for Scripps acquisition.

text.p: NEW YORK, September 11 (LPC) - Bank of New York Corp, Chase Manhattan Corp and NationsBank Corp are backing Comcast Corp's $1.6 billion stock acquisition of the television operations of E.W. Scripps Co with a $600 million bank loan, according to banking sources.
Pricing on the five-year revolver starts at 62.5 basis points over the London Inter-Bank Offered Rate, with a 20-basis-point fee on undrawn amounts, bankers said.
The following four additional banks have joined the credit as co-agents, a banker said: Barclays Bank, Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce, Royal Bank of Canada and Toronto-Dominion Bank.
Comcast is planning to acquire a division of Scripps accounting for 750,000 subscribers, according to bankers.
